reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing shared getRangedAmount and getWorstCaseAmount and keeps using the existing getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: No logic is added outside the two shared functions; each body is a one-line replacement.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts, the module every server and client consumer already calls for expected schedule amounts.

scope.why: Only the two rule functions, their comments, one stale comment in forecast, the tests and a release note change.

maintainability.why: Math.min and amount minus tolerance state the 'lowest value allowed' rule directly in one place, with tests covering the spanning-zero case.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All amount consumers already go through getRangedAmount/getWorstCaseAmount/getScheduledAmount; the diff edits only those definitions.
